# img2pdf: Image to PDF Scanner

> img2pdf is a free, privacy-first iOS app by Quan Dang that converts photos, receipts, paper paperwork, and scans into clean, compact PDFs entirely on-device. Built for iPhone and iPad running iOS 18.0 or later, it requires no account or sign-up, makes zero cloud uploads, contains no ads, and never adds a watermark. Features include camera scanning with edge detection, visual drag-and-drop page reordering, US Letter and A4 page formatting, on-device OCR for searchable text, digital signatures, permanent redactions, and file size estimation with compression presets.

## Comparisons
- [Comparison Index](https://dangquan1402.github.io/img2pdf/compare/): Directory comparing img2pdf against iPhone scanner tools and apps.
- [img2pdf vs Apple Notes Scanner](https://dangquan1402.github.io/img2pdf/compare/apple-notes-scanner/): Built-in iOS scanner convenience versus dedicated page layouts, reordering, and email compression.
- [img2pdf vs Adobe Scan](https://dangquan1402.github.io/img2pdf/compare/adobe-scan/): Adobe Document Cloud ecosystem and sign-in requirements versus 100% on-device offline privacy.
- [img2pdf vs Genius Scan](https://dangquan1402.github.io/img2pdf/compare/genius-scan/): The Grizzly Labs enterprise cloud auto-upload tool versus free included on-device OCR and encryption.
- [img2pdf vs iLovePDF](https://dangquan1402.github.io/img2pdf/compare/ilovepdf/): Broad web-first PDF suite with server uploads versus private native iOS processing with zero quotas.
- [img2pdf vs Smallpdf](https://dangquan1402.github.io/img2pdf/compare/smallpdf/): Team-oriented cloud document portal with subscription paywalls versus unlimited, free on-device scanning.
- [img2pdf vs Online Web PDF Converters](https://dangquan1402.github.io/img2pdf/compare/online-pdf-converters/): Privacy, speed, and offline capability differences between native iOS processing and browser upload portals.
